request: Try combining sequential training updates using jax.lax.scan.

decision.reason: Small loop-only speedup does not repay the extra preload and compilation/warmup in complete training. Preserve the current simple production path.

implementation.scope: Sequential updates within one epoch, preserving RNG view order, global LR step, SH degree, statistics, densification and opacity/reorder boundaries. The scan carries Adam, statistics, pool, last loss, overflow OR and max pair count, and returns no per-step output arrays. Targets and camera leaves stack once; only view indices are passed at each epoch. Mixed camera shapes retain the original sequential path.
implementation.binding: nnx.jit_partial(graph=False), donation of TrainingState; jax.lax.scan with default unroll and with unroll=4.
implementation.limitations: Single scene (bicycle), 8x16 tiles, default Optax; small-scene correctness additionally covers Muon and CuTe. No evidence for CPU-bound scenes or larger datasets.

fixed_model_scalar_scan.protocol: same checkpoint, SH3, Optax, 4 preloaded views, same randomized 544-view sequence, 32 warmups and 512 timed updates, 32-update scan chunks, three alternating rounds; other GPU processes monitored every 0.5 seconds

full_training_unroll4.protocol: Bicycle images_4 eval=true, defaults (8x16 tile, 1M capacity, Optax, seed 0, 8M pair capacity), 169 train and 25 held-out views, 29913 updates; three fresh alternating baseline/scan-unroll4 rounds. Identical frozen baseline renderer evaluates every checkpoint. Other GPU processes monitored every 0.5 seconds.

+def update_scan(training, bounds, cameras, targets, first_step, radius, *, order, active_degree, collect_stats, overflow, peak_pairs, config, optimization, optimizer, max_steps):
+    initial = (training.adam.get_value(), training.fragments.get_value(), training.model.as_arrays(), jnp.float32(0), overflow, peak_pairs)
+
+    def update(carry, sample):
+        state, stats, pool, _, overflow, peak = carry
+        index, offset = sample
+        camera = jax.tree.map(lambda value: value[index], cameras)
+        pool, state, stats, metrics = compute_training_step(pool, state, stats, bounds, camera, targets[index], first_step + offset, radius, config, active_degree, collect_stats, max_steps=max_steps, optimizer=optimizer, optimization=optimization)
+        return (state, stats, pool, metrics['loss'], overflow | metrics['overflow'], jnp.maximum(peak, metrics['pairs'])), None
+
+    (state, stats, pool, loss, overflow, peak), _ = jax.lax.scan(update, initial, (order, jnp.arange(order.shape[0], dtype=jnp.int32)), unroll=4)
+    training.adam.set_value(state)
+    training.fragments.set_value(stats)
+    training.model.update_from_arrays(pool)
+    return loss, overflow, peak
+
+
+def bind_scan(training, config, *, max_steps=None, optimization=_DEFAULT_OPTIMIZATION, optimizer='optax'):
+    return nnx.jit_partial(partial(update_scan, config=config, optimization=optimization, optimizer=optimizer, max_steps=max_steps), training, graph=False, static_argnames=('active_degree', 'collect_stats'), donate_argnums=(0,))
